TextView.android:text: Configure developer options and simulation data.
Reads actual ESP32 hardware sensors while automatic cultivation control is paused.
Actuator hysteresis, not a target range: Start is the water depth that opens the solenoid; Stop is the depth that closes it again. Working depth is 0-6 cm.

Commands the Canopy Fan directly at a fixed percentage, independent of temperature/humidity automation. Requires Manual Mode (enable it on the Monitoring screen first). This verifies the commanded PWM output only - the ESP32 Serial log shows the resulting [CANOPY-PWM] duty value. The hardware has no tachometer, so actual physical RPM can never be confirmed from software.
MANUAL MODE IS OFF - enable it on the Monitoring screen to send test commands
Developer testing only. Selecting a subsystem pauses unrelated automatic controllers. Real sensors, actuators, safety checks, and manual controls remain active.

Overrides only the current time Grow Light scheduling sees while Grow Light Schedule test mode is selected. The real clock/RTC is never modified, and this has no effect once test mode is switched away.
The system temporarily ignores automatic refill and low-water actuator safety while continuing to monitor and report the real water level.
